With reference to the attached translation from the
"Nippo", I have to state that the following information has
been obtained from the local Japanese Consular Police
regarding an American Buddhist monk named Lewis A. Colburn,
aged 27, who was deported from Japan as an undesirable and
who arrived here by the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru" on March 2;-
This person was born in Idaho, U.S.A. in 1909, and,
after finishing a commercial school course, he joined the
U.S. Navy as a stoker in 1926 and in 1930 he had to leave the
service after the expiration of a term of detention, having
been charged with assaulting a senior officer. Leaving the
Navy, he obtained employment in a factory in his native place,
where he remained for about one year, during which time he
became interested in Buddhism.
In 1931, he went to San Francisco and became acquainted
with a Japanese Buddhist monk named Chizaki Jyogen, who, on
learning that he was eager to study Buddhism, gave him a letter
of introduction to the Rev. Maruyama, the chief abbot of the
Daitokuji sect of Japanese Buddhism in Kyoto, Japan.
Colburn, having obtained a letter of introduction to
to one of the most prominent Japanese Buddhists, went to Japan
by the s.s. "Taiyo Maru" on February 8, 1931, accompanied by
a friend named F. M. Ormsby. On arrival, he went to Kyoto
and entered the Daitokuji Temple to study Buddhism. Whilst
there, he had sexual relations with a Japanese lady, Fusao
Shibuya, who, being a graduate of a Women's College of English
Literature in Tokyo, acted as an interpreter between the
Buddhist Tutor and Colburn. The scandal which ensued caused
much trouble between Mrs. Shibuya and her husband, and led to

关于随附的《日日报》（Nippo）译文，本人须说明，已从当地日本领事馆警察处获得以下有关一名名为刘易斯·A·科尔本（Lewis A. Colburn）、现年27岁的美国佛教僧侣的情报。此人因被视为不受欢迎分子而被日本驱逐，并于3月2日乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船抵达此地：
此人于1909年出生于美国爱达荷州，在完成商业学校课程后，于1926年作为司炉加入美国海军。1930年，他因被指控袭击上级军官，在服刑期满后不得不离开部队。离开海军后，他在家乡的一家工厂找到工作，在那里待了大约一年，在此期间他对佛教产生了兴趣。
1931年，他前往旧金山，结识了一位名为千崎如幻（Chizaki Jyogen）的日本佛教僧侣。后者得知他渴望学习佛教后，给他写了一封介绍信，引荐给日本京都大德寺派的首席住持丸山牧师（Rev. Maruyama）。
科尔本获得了这位日本著名佛教人士的介绍信后，于1931年2月8日在一位名为 F. M. 奥姆斯比（F. M. Ormsby）的朋友陪同下，乘坐“太阳丸”号轮船前往日本。抵达后，他前往京都，进入大德寺学习佛教。在那里期间，他与一位日本女士涉谷房雄（Fusao Shibuya）发生了性关系。涉谷女士是东京一所女子学院英国文学专业的毕业生，在佛教导师和科尔本之间担任翻译。随之而来的丑闻导致涉谷女士与其丈夫之间产生诸多麻烦，并导致

in July, 1931, on this account.
On August 27, 1931, Colburn left Japan on a pilgrimage
to Siam and India.
On May 21, 1932, Mrs. Shibuya gave birth to a boy by
Colburn.
Upon Colburn's return to Japan on December 10, 1935,
Mrs. Shibuya came to Kobe and re-cohabited with him. Colburn,
however, had no means of livelihood and used to solicit alms
from the Indian residents in Kobe.
The Kobe Police again took an interest into Colburn's
activities, and as a result he was deported from Japan to
Shanghai on February 13, 1936, as an undesirable. Colburn
has since left Shanghai for the U.S.A., having passed through
Kobe on the m.v. "Asama Maru" on March 10, 1936.

他们离婚。科尔本因此于1931年7月被逐出寺庙。
1931年8月27日，科尔本离开日本，前往暹罗和印度朝圣。
1932年5月21日，涉谷女士生下了科尔本的一个男孩。
1935年12月10日科尔本返回日本后，涉谷女士来到神户并与他重新同居。然而，科尔本没有生计来源，常常向神户的印度居民乞讨施舍。
神户警察再次对科尔本的活动产生兴趣，结果他于1936年2月13日作为不受欢迎分子被日本驱逐至上海。此后，科尔本已离开上海前往美国，他于1936年3月10日途经神户，乘坐“浅间丸”号机动船离开。

March 2, 1936. Afternoon TranslationI

NIPPO

AMERICAN MONK EXPELLD FROM JAPAN

An American Buddhist monk
named L. A. Corvan, age 26, dressed in Japanese
clothing, who was expelled from Japan for his
relations with a Japanese woman, arrived in Shanghai
on the S. S. Nagasaki Maru at 6.30 p.m. yesterday.
He will stay in the Foreign Y.M.C.A. on Bubbling Well
Road.

J S Kamakura
Jack

《日日报》

美国僧侣被日本驱逐

一名名为 L. A. 科尔万（L. A. Corvan）、现年26岁、身着日本服装的美国佛教僧侣，因与一名日本女性有染而被日本驱逐，于昨日下午6时30分乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船抵达上海。
他将入住静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的外国青年会。

J S Kamakura

《字林西报》，1936年3月3日，星期二

美国僧侣因“丑闻恋情”
被日本驱逐

一名美国佛教僧侣，据称26岁，据说是因为涉及一名日本女性的“丑闻恋情”而被日本驱逐，上周末出现在上海，引起了所有碰巧看到他的人的注意。他身着日式服装，包括日本的“木屐”（geta）。
当地日文报纸昨天早上通过声明解开了与此人有关的任何谜团，称他抵达此处时乘坐的是长崎丸号。日本媒体还补充说，他将入住外国青年会，但在该机构进行的核查显示，没有任何符合其描述的人登记入住。新闻报道中未透露其姓名。

与有关比丘皮内达（Bhikshu Pineda）及其弟子的文件归档。
S.W.
